title: Rahiman Dhaga Prem
desc: Javed Akhtar says every human has some thoughts and expectations from life. He further says life is a formation of various elements and is full of ups and downs while death is a destruction of these elements.

title: Kahi Rahim
desc: Javed Akhtar takes us through various shayaris where sharab is used as a symbol to explain a concept that talks about various examples of life.

title: Rahiman Priti
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the word 'Awaaz' and its various forms, the one that we use to talk to others, the one that we raise as an opinion and the one that is within us.
